description: 电影海报、社媒配图、国潮海报、品牌海报、自然科普海报等

presets.text_rendering: exact text rendering, no extra words
presets.quality: high resolution, suitable for social media

pitfalls: 主视觉必须写清楚具体是什么，不能只说'做一张海报'
主标题和副标题都要写死，否则模型疯狂加戏瞎编文字
自然科普海报主体必须极度放大占50-70%画面
国潮海报文字即设计元素，要在prompt中写明每段文字的内容和位置
文字排版要精确描述（如'左上大号竖排'），不能笼统说'添加中文文字'

filled.theme: CATHERINE THE GREAT — Empress of All Russia, 1729-1796

typography.headline: CATHERINE / THE GREAT
typography.subheading: EMPRESS. REFORMER. LEGEND. / FROM PRINCESS TO IMMORTAL.
typography.layout: Top-left: small white uppercase serif text with character name, dates, narrative lines. Center: heraldic double-headed eagle Romanov crest. Bottom: massive 3D polished gold uppercase title with filigree scroll ornamentation and small crown above. Below title: gold handwritten-script tagline. Very bottom: small white uppercase taglines.

visuals.subject: Multi-layered composition — (1) Upper right: giant semi-translucent profile bust portrait of Catherine facing right, warm golden sunlight on one half, other half in shadow, hair dissolving into storm clouds (ghost portrait element). (2) Center foreground: full-body standing portrait in ornate royal gown with gold embroidery, ermine-trimmed royal cloak, blue Order of St. Andrew sash, small crown, holding golden scepter with eagle ornament. (3) Background: St. Petersburg baroque palaces with gilded onion domes on right, 18th-century imperial sailing ships with double-headed eagle flags on left. (4) Bottom: churning dark blue-grey seawater, waves crashing around hem of gown.
visuals.style: Hollywood historical epic biopic poster, dramatic chiaroscuro lighting, dark storm clouds contrasted with golden sunlight breaking through, rich polished gold + deep royal blue + cream/ivory palette
visuals.color_palette: Rich gold (#D4AF37), deep royal blue (#1B2A4A), cream/ivory (#FFFFF0), charcoal grey (#36454F), warm golden highlights

filled.vibe: Grandeur, regal authority, epic historical drama, power and destiny
